schema:
CREATE TABLE authors (author_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT);
CREATE TABLE books (book_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, author_id INTEGER, year INTEGER);
correct_query: SELECT a.name FROM authors AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM books AS b1 WHERE a.author_id = b1.author_id AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM books AS b2 WHERE b2.author_id = b1.author_id AND b2.year = 2020))
